help.main:
Dice!Next Help
- Roll: .r .rh .rb/.rp .ww .dx
- Checks: .ra .rc .rav .sc(san) .en(grow)
- Cards: .st .pc (multi-card)
- Generate: .coc .dnd .name
- Decks: .deck .draw .gacha
- Fun: .jrrp .nn .set
- Admin: .bot .group .log .ob .dismiss .send
Type .help <cmd> for details (e.g. .help ra); .helpdoc lists all topics.
help.entry_missing: Help entry "{entry}" is not available yet; please check the docs.
help.unknown: No help found for "{topic}". Try .helpdoc for available topics.
help.ambiguous: "{topic}" matches several help topics: {list}. Please be more specific.

topic.r: Roll .r [expr] [reason]: roll dice. e.g. .r3d6+2 attack; .rh hidden; N#expr repeat.
topic.rh: Hidden .rh [expr] [reason]: hidden roll / hidden check. The result is DM'd to you; the group only sees "<name> made a hidden roll". Hidden checks use .rah / .rch (e.g. .rah Spot 60). House rules (.setcoc) and bonus/penalty dice still apply.
topic.ra: Check .ra <skill|attr> [rate] [reason]: COC check. Reads the card if rate omitted. e.g. .ra spot / .ra str60
topic.rx: Psychology .rx @investigator [rate]: hidden Psychology roll (for Keepers). Rolls a Psychology check against the @'d investigator; the detailed result with success level is DM'd to you, while the group only sees a non-spoiler receipt. Reads the target card's Psychology if rate omitted, default 10.
topic.rb: Bonus/penalty .rb/.rp [N] [check]: bonus/penalty dice (keep low/high tens). e.g. .rb spot
topic.sc: Sanity .sc success/fail [san]: sanity check, auto-deducts SAN and saves to card. e.g. .sc 1/1d6
topic.st:
Attributes .st str50 dex60: set/modify attributes (+/- and dice ok, e.g. hp-2, san+1d3). DND coins support pp/gp/ep/sp/cp and automatically make change when spending. .st show
.st clr
.st del <attr>.
topic.pc:
Multi-card .pc: .pc new <name>
.pc tag <name>
.pc list
.pc del <name>
.pc @someone to view their card.
topic.npc:
NPC .npc: group-shared character cards.
.npc new <name>
.npc list
.npc <name> st str50 to set attributes
.npc <name> ra spot to roll as that NPC
.npc show/del/clr <name>.
topic.dnd: Chargen .dnd [count]: generate DND stats (4d6 keep highest 3).
topic.jrrp: Luck .jrrp: luck of the day (fixed per person per day).
topic.bot:
Bot .bot: version/status
.bot on/off enable/disable this group (only .bot works when off).
topic.group: Group .group: view this group's settings. Edit in the web admin.
topic.ob:
Observe .ob: observe this group's session
.ob list
.ob exit
.ob clr.
topic.send: Message .send <message>: forward a message to the Master. Master can .send group/user <id> <msg>.
topic.log:
Log .log new [name] start recording
.log on/off resume/pause
.log end finish & upload (link + group file)
.log halt finish without uploading
.log list
.log get [name] re-upload for link
.log del <name>
.log stat [name]
.log export [name] group file only
.log type txt/html file format (group admin)
.log time/timer
.log masterget <group> [name] (master).
topic.nn: Nickname .nn <name>: set your display name in the bot; .nn to clear.
topic.set:
Default die .set <sides>: set the default die (used by bare .r)
.set resets to 100.
topic.ww: Dice pool .ww N [success-line]: WOD adding dice pool. Legacy .ww 5 or .ww 5 7 uses 10 as the add line; extended .ww 10a8c7+2 uses a=add line (default 10), c=success line (default 8), and +2=extra successes. Successful dice use circled numerals and every round is shown.
topic.dx: Double-Cross .dx <count>c<crit> (e.g. .dx 3c8) or .dx <count> <crit>: Double-Cross dice — d10 reaching the crit value explodes; tallies per the DX rules. A DX-specific exploding check, not a plain roll.
topic.rav: Opposed .rav A B [@target]: opposed check — both roll d100, compare success level first, then the roll on a tie. e.g. .rav fighting 60 / .rav spot @someone.
topic.ba: BRP check .ba <skill|attr> [rate] [reason]: BRP check (roll-under d100). Levels: critical ≤ skill/20, special ≤ skill/5, success ≤ skill, failure > skill, fumble (100, or 99 on a failure). Reads the card if rate omitted; supports @someone proxy and N# multi. e.g. .ba spot / .ba fighting60.
topic.bav: Resistance .bav <active> <passive>: BRP resistance table. target% = 50 + (active − passive)×5; roll 1d100 ≤ target → active wins. Active/passive may be attribute names (read from card) or numbers. e.g. .bav STR SIZ.
topic.en: Growth .en <skill> [value] [([fail-growth]/)success-growth]: COC skill growth — roll d100; if > current value (or >95) it grows and saves to the card. Growth starts with +/- (default +1d10); batch with .en a b or a|b.
topic.ti: Madness .ti temporary / .li indefinite: draw a COC7 madness symptom (with fear/mania subtables) for when a character loses sanity.
topic.setcoc:
House rule .setcoc <0-7>: set this group's COC check house rule (different critical/fumble rulings). .setcoc show to view
.setcoc clr to clear.
topic.name: Names .name [cn/en/jp] [count]: random names (Chinese/English/Japanese), optional count; alias .gn.
topic.sleep: Rest .sleep: take a rest — returns a rest message.
topic.mrrp: Luck .mrrp: tomorrow's luck — deterministic per user per day, peek at tomorrow.
topic.zrrp: Luck .zrrp: yesterday's luck — deterministic per user per day, look back at yesterday.
topic.lang:
Language .lang: view or switch the bot's reply language. .lang 简体/繁體/en/日本語 to switch
.lang clr to clear override.
topic.favor: Favor system: "好感" shows favor + title; "好感排行"/"群内好感排行" show rankings. Owner/trusted (trust>=4) can use .favor add[n]/grow/set<n>/clr (optionally @someone). Higher favor grows slower.
topic.hiy: Stats .hiy [skill]: check stats. No arg = overall; with a skill = that skill's rolls/successes/rate/level breakdown.
topic.setsn: Group card .setsn <attrs...>: owner/admin sets which attributes the group .sn card shows (up to 5; default hp san dex).
topic.sn:
Group card .sn [template]: set your own group card by template
.sn off clears. Affected by .setsn.
topic.ri:
Initiative .ri [±mod] [name]: initiative d20+mod
.init list
.init clr
.init del.
topic.welcome:
Welcome .welcome <text>: set the join welcome ({at} supported)
.welcome show / off.
topic.dismiss: Leave .dismiss: make the bot leave this group (admin/master).
topic.rules: Rules .rules <term> / .rules <book>:<term> — quick rule lookup (e.g. .rules coc:fumble); .ruleset <book> sets the group default book.
topic.plugin:
Plugins .plugin list shows plugins and their per-group status
.plugin on|off <name> toggles one
.plugin all on|off toggles all. Group admins only.
topic.game:
Game table .game:
.game new <name> create (creator becomes GM)
.game open <16-char code> attach this group to a game (GM)
.game join / exit
.game master claim GM or list GMs
.game state
.game set <var> <val> table variable (GM)
.game call @all players (GM)
.game kick <QQ> (GM)
.game close close this group's area
.game over end the game
.game rou <faces>[*copies] roulette dice (GM); rou hist/reset/clr
